subject: MSBA Statement of Interest and Security Upgrades
overview: The School Committee approved a Statement of Interest for Medford High School renovations and authorized funding for district-wide security camera upgrades. The body also reviewed reports on student math tutoring, college application fee waivers, and a community vaping prevention program.

items.title: Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the February 5 meeting, as well as various bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Superintendent Search Committee Report
items.summary: Received a report regarding the superintendent search and announced public focus groups scheduled for February 15.

items.title: MSBA Statement of Interest
items.summary: Approved submitting a revised Statement of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority for renovation and infrastructure projects at Medford High School. The committee also voted to forward the proposal to the City Council for its approval.

items.title: MSBA Funding Match
items.summary: Approved a recommendation to forward a request to the City Council for $291,150 from free cash to meet the local match requirements for the MSBA project.

items.title: Security System Upgrades
items.summary: Approved a $203,000 request for security camera repairs and upgrades district-wide and requested a separate status report on school doors and locks.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: Accepted the financial report following discussion on payroll reclassifications, utility costs, solar panel installation, and community use of school facilities.

items.title: Columbus School After-School Tutoring
items.summary: Reviewed a report on the new math tutoring program for grades three through five and requested a follow-up on the progress of current sixth-grade students.

items.title: SAT Fee Waiver Correlation
items.summary: Discussed a report examining the correlation between free and reduced lunch eligibility and the utilization of SAT and college application fee waivers.

items.title: Vaping Information Program
items.summary: Received an update on a community event regarding student vaping and discussed ongoing prevention strategies, including health class curriculum changes.

items.title: Resolutions and Old Business
items.summary: Adopted resolutions of condolence and approved minor spelling and formatting corrections to the district field trip form.
